summary: New Fortress Energy filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026, disclosing that its Fast LNG unit is offline after a mechanical failure of the facility's gas turbine. The company said it is working with the turbine manufacturer to restore operations and expects the unit back in service during the fourth quarter. No financial terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed. This is an operational update under Item 8.01, not a special situation; the risk-arb angle centers on production disruption, spot LNG sourcing costs, and timely repairs.
